file: 339 The Scariest Free Game Was Made by a Studio That Didnt Exist Part 2.mp4

lines.t: Part 2. P.T. came from a fake studio. And the real answer shocked everyone.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: It was a teaser for a new Silent Hill game. Silent Hills. By Hideo Kojima and Guillermo del Toro, starring Norman Reedus.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: Over a million people downloaded it.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: Then in April 2015, Silent Hills was cancelled. And P.T. was pulled from the PlayStation Store.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: Now you can't download it again. PS4s with P.T. still installed were listed on eBay for over 1,000 dollars.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: Would you play P.T. alone at night?

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)
